0022600026.text: The Celtics, who are 6-2 and sit second in the Atlantic 1.5 games back and third in the East, visit the 3-6 Hornets, who have lost five straight and are ninth in the East, in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game. Boston has gone 1-2 on the road and 5-0 at home, while Charlotte is 2-3 at home. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7, 2026. Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness), and Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps).
